references.title: de.wikipedia: Visby
references.supports: Visby on Gotland, in older German Wisby

notes.rationale: »beinahe nach Wisby«, the town on Gotland, a place name with a Core gender (Neut, Rule de/proper-noun-article). No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root wisby and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
